_meta.purpose: Curated, step-by-step treatment plans used by treatment tracking. Chemical options are taken only from the TNAU Agritech Portal crop protection pages; the LLM never chooses products or doses.
_meta.review_note: Products and doses were copied from the TNAU pages linked per disease. Care steps without a TNAU page are general, low-risk cultural practices. An agronomist must review this file before production use, and product registration status must be re-checked periodically.

care: Collect and destroy fallen leaves and pruned material - the fungus survives the winter in them.
